MSU Working Fund

From the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects" (lesson 8 of 15).
The Morgan State Working Fund
The MSU Working Fund allows Principal Investigators to establish a controlled petty cash pool to provide participant incentives (e.g., for surveys, focus groups, or similar activities). This fund in administered by the Office of the Comptroller in coordination with the Office of the Bursar.

Checklist: Ready for a Working Fund?
Workflow access granted?
A critical first step in the working fund process involves entering a requisition in Banner: Finance Self-Service. To do so, a PIs supervisor (e.g., Chair or Dean) or Budget Officer can submit a request through Banner Workflow on behalf of the PI. The PI can submit workflow requests on behalf of their project employees as needed. Instructions on how to submit a Workflow request can be found in the Navigating Banner: Essentials for Research Administration e-module.
Funds available in pool 08: contractual services?
In Banner, the working fund is charged to the Contractual Services Pool (Account: 08211) . The initiator must verify sufficient funds are available in Contractual Services prior to requisition entry. In a case of insufficient funds, a budget transfer may be necessary.
fund custodian identified?
A Fund Custodian is the named individual responsible for maintaining and reconciling fund disbursements under the MSU Working Fund. The custodian is named on the disbursement checks and must pick up those checks in person from the Bursar in Tyler Hall. A PI will typically act as the fund custodian for a project. However, on larger projects with dedicated admin support (e.g., program manager) those individuals may act as the custodian at the PIs designation.
Working Fund Process Management

MSU Working Fund: Initiation & Management
Next Steps
Great Work!
Enter a Requisition in Finance Self-Service Banner
The first step in the working fund process is to enter a requisition in Banner for the full amount you plan to disburse to participants. For assistance with requisitions, you can refer to the How To: Banner Requisition Entry lesson in this module. Consider the following: The correct Banner account code is 08211: Survey Incentives. The requisition should not be entered by the Fund Custodian directly. Please seek assistance from an admin or supervisor with budget access. Vendor ID # = Fund Custodian's MSU ID #. The 'item description' should read something like "to establish a working fund for research participant incentives". The requisition dollar amount should equal the full amount you plan to disburse. For example, if you will run five focus groups costing $1,000 per group in incentives, you would enter a $5,000 requisition.
Supporting Document: Fund Custodian Agreement
The first supporting document that must be completed is the Working Fund Custodian Agreement. Here, the PI and their supervisor will name and approve the fund custodian for the working fund. The agreement (attached below) should be carefully reviewed.
Supporting Document: Fund Advance Request Form
The second supporting document is the Fund Advance Request Form. An example of the completed form is included below. Consider the following: "ID#" = Fund Custodian MSU ID# The research fund period cannot exceed 180 days . If an extension is necessary, a new advance request form must be submitted with an updated performance period. Enter the newly created requisition number (REQ#) in the top right corner.
Submit through DocuSign
Create a DocuSign envelope so supporting documents can be approved and ultimately processed by the Office of the Comptroller. The approval queue should include the following: Fund Custodian PI PI Supervisor (typically a Chair or Dean) ORA (in DocuSign as 'MSU ORA: Signing Group') travel.comptroller@morgan.edu (as 'receives copy')
Pickup the Disbursement Check
Once the working fund is set up, the Office of the Comptroller will send a check request to the Bursar. To determine if a check is available for pickup please click here and enter the Fund Custodian's MSU ID#. If a check is available it will be listed as "Available for Pickup".
Disburse Incentives and Maintain Logs
With funds in hand, the custodian is free to start providing incentives. As noted in the Fund Custodian Agreement, it is the responsibility of the custodian to maintain a receipt log of all fund disbursements. For research working funds, this would entail maintaining a receipt log to for each incentive payment to include the following: Name of Participant (if research is not sensitive) Participant email address Dollar Amount (not to exceed $100 without prior approval) Payment Date This can be maintained via a paper log if the research is done in person. Additionally, you will need to provide a copy of your proof of purchase of any gift cards used for the working fund. If research is remote/virtual, you may create a Google Form, to capture this information and populate an associated spreadsheet. The timestamp for form submission by the participant is acceptable in lieu of a signature. Examples of a Google form and associated spreadsheet are included below.
Submit Logs and Request Additional Disbursements
Let's assume you requested the full $1000 max allowed for a working fund disbursement. You have finished your research activity (focus group, survey, etc.) and have a completed detailed log of incentive payments. Your next step is to email that completed log to travel.comptroller@morgan.edu and request the next check disbursement (if applicable). Repeat steps 5-7 as needed until the research working fund is depleted, the research period on the advance request lapses, or research is completed (whichever occurs first).
Additional Guidance
Be cautious when using the working fund to provide gift cards to study participants. The State of Maryland will not accept gift cards as part of the reconciliation process. For example, assume a fund custodian requests a $1000 disbursement and uses it to buy $1000 in gift cards. Unforeseen circumstances make it so the project is only able to recruit $700 worth of participants. The State will tell the custodian to keep the remaining $300 in gift cards and remit $300 from their personal funds.
